pages.title: Tiny Kingdoms
pages.creator: Rick&Jean
pages.description: Tiny Kingdoms is a strategy game about developing a settlement and sending its army to conquer new territory. Collect resources, improve buildings, recruit soldiers and arrange your formation before battle. Rally and Barrage give you actions to use during combat. Progress through the Tribal, Medieval and Industrial ages, choosing perks and carrying legacies forward while accounting for soldiers lost in battle.

pages.title: Vortex Ball
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Vortex Ball sends a rolling ball through an endless tunnel where obstacles interrupt your path. Steer with WASD or by dragging the mouse, avoiding hazards while gathering gems. Spend those gems on additional balls in the shop. The shifting tunnel becomes harder as the run continues, making survival and a higher score depend on your reactions.

pages.title: Stick vs Monster School 2
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Stick vs Monster School 2 pits a stickman against zombies and bosses in a series of combat levels. Move with the arrow keys and attack using Space or E. Clear the enemies from a level to advance, collecting coins along the way. New guns and character upgrades let you improve your fighting strength for the battles ahead.

pages.title: Pet Me Maze
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Pet Me Maze is a puzzle game about guiding a pet's head through winding passages. Tap to direct it through the maze, keeping away from traps while looking for treasures. Each level changes the route and hazards you must navigate, so inspect the available passages before choosing where the pet should go next.

pages.title: Balloon Pop Frenzy
pages.creator: Zoomie Games
pages.description: Balloon Pop Frenzy challenges you to score points by clicking or tapping floating balloons. Ordinary balloons and gold balloons are targets, while skull balloons must be left alone. Keep distinguishing safe targets from dangerous ones as the difficulty rises. The challenge comes from choosing what to pop quickly without tapping a skull by mistake.

pages.title: Fix Da Brainrot
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fix Da Brainrot turns pictures into jigsaws made of irregular scraps of torn paper. Choose a 16-piece puzzle or the more demanding 32-piece option, then drag each fragment into its matching position. Compare the edges and picture details to rebuild the image, fitting the scattered scraps together until the whole scene is restored.

pages.title: Pimple Squeeze
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Pimple Squeeze is a skin-cleaning game built around popping pimples and removing blackheads. Tap and squeeze the blemishes, using the available skincare tools to clean the character's face. Its short levels include popping sounds and combo bonuses, with further challenges becoming available as you work through the cleanup tasks.

pages.title: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship puts large trucks into arcade racing events across different tracks and terrain. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, steering the heavy vehicle through each course while competing for position. The focus is racing rather than hauling cargo, with different truck types taking part in the championship's driving challenges.

pages.title: Tap Gallery
pages.creator: Pixasoft Infotech™
pages.description: Tap Gallery is a block-clearing puzzle in which removing arrow-marked pieces reveals a hidden picture. Tap a block to move it in the direction shown, planning an order that lets you clear the arrangement efficiently. Boosters can help remove several blocks when you are stuck. Work through increasingly complicated puzzles to uncover more images.

pages.title: Crush the Eggs
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Crush the Eggs is a drawing puzzle where your sketch becomes the object that breaks an egg. Draw in the area above the platform with the mouse or a touch gesture, then let the finished shape fall. Choose its form and placement so it lands on the egg with enough effect to destroy it and open the next level.

pages.title: Snake Puzzle 3D
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Snake Puzzle 3D asks you to untangle a knot of intertwined snakes. Use the mouse to move a snake and work out how to separate it from the others. Follow the curves and crossings to decide which part to move next, gradually freeing the colored snakes from the tangled arrangement.

pages.title: The Grench Couple Holiday Dress up
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: The Grench Couple Holiday Dress up is a festive fashion game starring the Grench and his partner. Click the available clothing choices to put together holiday outfits for the couple. Experiment with the wardrobe and coordinate their looks, using the seasonal theme as the starting point for your own outfit combinations.

pages.title: Zumbia Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Zumbia Quest is a marble-shooting puzzle game where shots must join matching colors. Aim to create groups of at least three and remove the marbles required by each level. Timed challenges, special marbles and three boosters add different ways to approach the puzzles. Progress through the chapters to encounter new environments and unlock additional marble shooters.

pages.title: Sheep vs Wolf
pages.creator: Wonderkid Development
pages.description: Sheep vs Wolf is a turn-based puzzle about keeping a wolf away from the sheep. Click a hexagonal cell to block it, then watch the wolf take its own turn. Every barrier changes the available routes, so consider the wolf's next move before placing one. Build your defense by cutting off paths across the grid.

pages.title: Us Army Car Games Truck Driving
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Us Army Car Games Truck Driving is a military transport simulator focused on driving army vehicles. Take part in supply and troop transportation, moving equipment, food and soldiers as part of your duties. WASD controls movement. The army setting gives the driving tasks their purpose as you handle transport needed to support military operations.

pages.title: Block Mania
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Block Mania is a block-placement puzzle that combines fitting shapes with clearing lines. Drag pieces onto the board and complete a row or column to remove it. Consider the blocks coming next when deciding where to place the current pieces, leaving useful spaces and setting up line clears to increase your score.

pages.title: Robot Transform Race
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Robot Transform Race combines robot racing with collecting items, avoiding obstacles and changing form. Guide your robot through the course while trying to finish ahead of its rivals. Strike nearby competitors to slow them down and pick up useful items, including missiles. The game also lets you customize your robot's appearance rather than relying only on ready-made skins.

pages.title: Dino Ranch
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Dino Ranch is a collection of dinosaur activities featuring Jon, Blitz and their ranch friends. Tasks include lassoing escaped compies, feeding Angus, guiding dinosaurs to the stable and helping compies cross a river. Other activities involve racing or flying past obstacles. Follow the prompts and interact with the screen by clicking or swiping to carry out each job.

pages.title: Horror Escape Granny Room
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Horror Escape Granny Room sends you through a dangerous location while a hostile granny and other monsters threaten your escape. Search for clues and gather keys to open more areas. Explore carefully, keeping clear of the creatures you encounter as you uncover the secrets needed to find a way out.

pages.title: Dragon Escape
pages.creator: Liones Games
pages.description: Dragon Escape is a stealth puzzle about guiding a small dinosaur through areas guarded by robots. Collect the sandwich and make your way to the exit without entering a robot's view. Laser traps are part of the level challenges. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, watching the guards and planning a safe route.

pages.title: Parkour Block 6
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Parkour Block 6 is a platforming skill game built around jumping between blocks. Work through its levels and new mechanics, or take on the tougher hardcore mode. On a keyboard, use WASD to move, Space to jump and Left Shift to run. Careful movement and well-timed jumps are central to reaching the end of each course.

pages.title: Bubbly Lab
pages.creator: Vacuvacu games
pages.description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle about collecting bubbles with a powerful vacuum cleaner. Position the vacuum and use its suction to guide every bubble into the flask, moving laboratory objects when they can help. On a computer, move the mouse to position the cleaner and hold the left button to activate it; touch controls provide separate movement and suction inputs.

pages.title: Fill & Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Fill & Sort Puzzle turns household organization into a series of small puzzles. Sort and arrange everyday objects, watching for details that need attention before an item belongs in its final place. Dirty shoes, for example, need cleaning before they go on the rack. A mischievous cat can disturb the arrangement, adding another complication to your tidying work.

pages.title: City Driver: Destroy Car
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: City Driver: Destroy Car rewards you for damaging cars in a destruction simulator. Crash your vehicle to earn money, then use the proceeds to expand your garage or improve your cars. On a computer, WASD handles driving, Space applies the handbrake and the left mouse button controls the camera. Aim for bigger damage to fund more destruction.

pages.title: Fashion Repair
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Fashion Repair gives worn and dirty accessories a second life. Clean a phone, remove dirt from a bag and stitch a damaged cap before refreshing their appearance. Choose new colors and add decorative accessories to finish the repairs. Use the mouse to carry out the cleaning, sewing and styling tasks as you restore each item.

pages.title: Beat the Plush
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Beat the Plush is a weapon-based clicker where repeated attacks earn progress toward stronger equipment. Hold the screen to shoot, then spend your earnings on weapons and upgrades. The buttons above the action let you purchase weapons, while holding an icon displays its upgrade information. Improve damage and income to work through the levels more efficiently.

pages.title: ColorBox Puzzle
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: ColorBox Puzzle challenges you to fit a set of colored block pieces into a given outline. Drag the shapes into position with the mouse, checking how their edges can share the available space. Complete the pattern without leaving gaps to solve the puzzle. Different layouts and difficulty levels give you new arrangements to work out.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Adventure
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Block Puzzle Adventure is a wooden block puzzle played on a 10-by-10 board. Drag shapes into open spaces and complete rows or columns to clear them and earn points. A storage space can hold an awkward piece for later use. Plan around the remaining gaps, because the game ends when the available blocks can no longer fit.

pages.title: Sudoku Challenges
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Sudoku Challenges presents number puzzles on a partially filled nine-by-nine grid. Complete the empty cells so every row, column and three-by-three box contains each digit from one through nine once. Select a cell, then choose a number below the board. Notes help track possible answers, while an eraser and hints provide tools for working through the puzzle.

pages.title: Ninja Slicer
pages.creator: Mihai Rusu
pages.description: Ninja Slicer is a grass-cutting puzzle where a sword must clear the grassy sections without hitting obstacles. Use swipes or the arrow keys to direct your movement across the level. Look at the arrangement before cutting and choose a route that covers the grass while keeping the blade away from anything blocking its path.

pages.title: Classic Solitaire Blue
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Classic Solitaire Blue offers the familiar card-sorting challenge with a choice of drawing one or three cards from the stock. Uncover cards and move them between the seven tableau columns, following rank and alternating-color rules. Your goal is to build four foundation piles by suit, starting with aces and continuing upward until every king is placed.

pages.title: Ricochet Arrow
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Ricochet Arrow gives you a bow and a set of levels filled with hostile skeletons. Aim your shots to eliminate the enemies, taking care that an arrow does not strike your own archer. There is no limit on arrows, so you can adjust your aim, but careless shooting can still put your character in danger.

pages.title: Tasty Match
pages.creator: Yellow Bird Games
pages.description: Tasty Match is a timed tile-connection puzzle about finding identical pairs. Remove matching tiles until the entire board is empty before the countdown ends. Linking tiles that are farther apart earns more stars, which contribute toward reward chests. As you progress, additional tile designs appear and the board arrangements become more complicated.

pages.title: Flying Motorbike Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Flying Motorbike Driving Simulator combines riding through city streets with taking the motorcycle into the air. Explore the game's world from the road or leave the traffic below and fly above it. The contrast between ground travel and flight is the main feature, letting you experience the same environment from two different perspectives.

pages.title: Seafloor Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Seafloor Racing takes car races beneath the ocean, putting you on underwater courses against computer-controlled opponents. Use WASD to drive and try to maintain your speed while navigating around obstacles. Each level challenges you to stay ahead without letting hazards interrupt your run, making a clear racing line as important as moving quickly.

pages.title: Desert Faces
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Desert Faces is a match-three puzzle with timed objectives across 25 levels. Swap faces to bring three matching ones together and remove them from the board. Check the task for the current stage and choose swaps that help complete it before the timer expires, rather than making matches without considering the goal.

pages.title: Faceball
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Faceball is an aiming puzzle where your ball must hit red characters while leaving the green characters safe. Drag to rotate the characters together, then release to throw. Study how their shared orientation affects the shot before letting go. Each level asks you to find an angle that reaches the targets without harming the characters you are protecting.

pages.title: Siege Hero Viking Vengeance
pages.creator: Blaster
pages.description: Siege Hero Viking Vengeance is a shooting puzzle about attacking Viking defenses while protecting innocent villagers. Look for vulnerable parts of the structures and click to fire at them. Choose your targets carefully to bring down the enemies, preserve the villagers and collect the treasure, using the arrangement of each scene to plan your shots.

pages.title: Feudalism 3
pages.creator: Vitaly
pages.description: Feudalism 3 puts you in a war between five factions, each with its own advantages and weaknesses. Choose a side and fight to expand its control across the continent. The mouse handles movement and attacks, while the number keys from one to nine activate skills. Use your faction's strengths as you battle toward conquering the world.

pages.title: Birds Lineup
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Birds Lineup is a sorting puzzle built around arranging different types of birds. Reorganize them until birds of the same type share a horizontal row. Look across the arrangement to identify which birds belong together and work toward completing each row. Tap to interact as you solve the lineup required to pass the level.

pages.title: Merge Pumpkin
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Merge Pumpkin is an endless merging puzzle with a vegetable theme. Click a connected group containing at least two matching vegetables to combine them into a higher-level item. Keep building up the sequence of vegetables as you work toward creating a large pumpkin. Choosing which linked group to merge determines how the arrangement develops.

pages.title: Evil Nun Schools Out
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Evil Nun Schools Out traps you in a school after detention and gives you five days to escape. Search for solutions to the puzzles that secure the main door while keeping quiet around the nun, who can hear your activity. Use WASD to move and F to interact with objects or hide as you look for a way out.

pages.title: Princess Beauty Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Princess Beauty Salon is a makeover game where a princess visits your salon for a new look. Use the available customization choices to shape her transformation and try different combinations. Tap to interact with the salon's options as you put together a style for the princess and complete her makeover.

pages.title: Motor Rush
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Motor Rush mixes motorcycle racing with attacks on rival riders. Strike opponents to disrupt their race while avoiding their attempts to knock you off course. The highway also contains obstacles that can end your run if you hit them. Keep track of both the racers around you and the road ahead as you fight for position.

pages.title: Easter Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Easter Mahjong Connection is a tile-pairing puzzle with Easter-themed pictures. Select two matching tiles that can be joined by an open path with at most two right-angle bends. Remove the pairs to empty the board, checking which routes are available as spaces open up. The challenge is finding legal connections for every remaining tile.

pages.title: Children Doctor Dentist 2
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Children Doctor Dentist 2 puts you in charge of a dental clinic for animal patients. Each visitor arrives with sore teeth and needs your help with treatment. Select and use the dental tools to carry out the care tasks for the animals. Mouse clicks or taps let you interact with the patients and equipment.

pages.title: Up and Down Ninja
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Up and Down Ninja is a score-chasing arcade game about collecting ninja stars while dodging other ninjas. Tap the screen to control your character's movement up and down, choosing when to change direction. Gather stars without colliding with anyone in your path, since hitting another ninja brings the run to an end.

pages.title: Match the Candies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Match the Candies is a puzzle where candy blocks enter the board from its edges. Push them in from the sides or from above and below to create matching groups of at least three. Remove every block to finish a stage. Across 30 levels, the aim is to plan placements that eventually leave the whole board empty.

pages.title: off road Oil Tanker Transport Truck
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: In off road Oil Tanker Transport Truck, you take the wheel of a large tanker on rough offroad routes. Use the keyboard arrows to steer and control the truck as you navigate the terrain. The focus is handling a heavy vehicle carefully, maintaining control along the paths rather than rushing through the driving challenge.

pages.title: Which meme cat are you?
pages.creator: napcloud
pages.description: Take an emoji quiz in Which meme cat are you? Choose one of the two emojis presented at each step and see which cat matches your answers after 15 choices. The game includes 18 meme cats to discover, giving you different results to look for as you try other combinations of emoji preferences.

pages.title: Dangerous Offroad Coach Bus Transport Simulator
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Dangerous Offroad Coach Bus Transport Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a coach on hilly mountain routes. Pick up passengers and take them to their destinations, negotiating sharp turns and offroad tracks along the way. Different buses and detailed interiors form the setting for a driving challenge centered on reaching each stop through difficult terrain.

pages.title: Punkte Verbinden
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Punkte Verbinden is a dot-connecting puzzle about tracing the ordered path through each shape. Use the mouse to drag between the points and connect them in sequence. Work out how the dots form the required figure as you progress through the levels across three worlds, completing each outline before moving to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Ragdoll Duel
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Ragdoll Duel is a shooting game about bringing down an opposing ragdoll before it defeats you. Aim and fire with the mouse or a finger, adjusting your shots to hit the other fighter. The duel centers on the exchange of gunfire between the two characters, with the goal of taking your opponent down first.

pages.title: Fun Zoo Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun Zoo Animals Jigsaw offers 12 animal pictures to rebuild from scattered puzzle pieces. Choose easy mode with 25 pieces, medium with 49 or hard with 100, then fit the fragments together to restore your chosen scene. Compare the picture details and edges as you assemble it, selecting the difficulty that suits the challenge you want.

pages.title: Jelly Mergence
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jelly Mergence combines dragging and merging jelly shapes with a score target. Move one jelly onto another of the same type to create a higher-level piece. Arrange the shapes and improve them as bouncing balls generate points on contact. Build up the scoring rate until it reaches the current level's goal, then continue toward a higher target.

pages.title: Cursed Treasure
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Cursed Treasure is a tower defense game where you defend an evil overlord's gems from invading heroes. Set up defenses using the forces of orcs, undead and demons, stopping the intruders before they can steal your treasure. Plan your defensive positions around the attackers' approach and keep the gems protected as you fight off their attempts to take them.

pages.title: Shopkins Coloring Book
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Shopkins Coloring Book lets you color eight pictures using a palette of 23 colors. Pick a picture and apply your chosen shades to give the characters a new appearance. Experiment with different combinations as you fill the drawing, then use the save option to keep the finished colored image. Interact with the pictures using the mouse or touch.

pages.title: Mosaic Fantasy
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Mosaic Fantasy is a picture-making game about placing colored mosaic pieces on a field. Select a color, then click the position where you want to use it. Repeat with different colors to build patterns, objects or larger pictures piece by piece. The process centers on choosing colors and deciding where each part of your design belongs.

pages.title: Square Area
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Square Area is a routing puzzle with colored squares, directional arrows, gates and stars. Tap a square to move the pieces of that color in their indicated directions. Arrows redirect them, while paired gates transfer them across the board. Work around obstacles and arrange the squares on matching stars to finish the level, using undo or reset when you need another approach.

pages.title: Tower Jump
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Tower Jump is a climbing arcade game where clicks or taps make your character leap between surfaces inside a tower. Time each jump to continue upward and avoid the spiked sections that threaten the climb. Watch the next surface before taking off, aiming to gain more height and improve the score of your run.

pages.title: Modern Slots
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Modern Slots is a collection of five slot-machine games. Choose a machine, adjust the number of active lines and the bet, then press Spin to turn the reels. Matching symbols pay along lines running from the leftmost reel toward the right. The machines also include special symbols and free-spin features, with an automatic spinning option available by holding the Spin button.

pages.title: Draw Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Draw Game is a physics puzzle about bringing a pink ball and a blue ball together. Draw lines and shapes that become physical objects, using their shape and position to influence how the balls move. Work around the obstacles in each layout and experiment with your drawings until the two balls meet to solve the level.

pages.title: American Football.io
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: American Football.io turns the stadium into a contest between competing teams. Tackle opponents as you advance and try to reach the end for a touchdown. Drag with the right mouse button to move through the action, working your way past the other teams. The goal is to break through the opposition and keep moving toward a scoring opportunity.

pages.title: Princess Lantern Festival
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Lantern Festival is a preparation and decorating game for a newly married couple attending a lantern celebration. Help create their lantern, then get the couple ready for the festival. Use the mouse to make your choices and combine the available design options, putting together both the lantern and the couple's appearance for the occasion.

pages.title: Stickman War
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Stickman War is a shooting game in which you must eliminate the stickman enemies to complete each level. Aim at the targets in the scene and keep track of your ammunition as you fire. Reload with R when needed, then continue clearing the enemies. A headshot indicator highlights accurate hits as you work through the stages.

pages.title: Exotic Cats Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Exotic Cats Jigsaw Puzzle gives you cat pictures to assemble at three difficulty settings. Choose easy, medium or hard, then work out how the pieces fit together to rebuild the image. There is no countdown, so you can take time comparing edges and picture details while completing each puzzle at your own pace.

pages.title: Dragon Battles Multiplayer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dragon Battles Multiplayer puts you in control of a dragon fighting other dragons and armed enemies on the ground. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space to rise and C to descend, and attack with fireballs or close-range strikes. Use the dragon's flight and attacks to reach opponents above the battlefield or on the ground.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter 3D
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Zombie Shooter 3D is a first-person shooting game about gunning down approaching zombies. Aim at the undead and use the available weapons to keep them from reaching you. Number keys one through six switch guns, while R reloads the current weapon. Watch the ammunition display and choose when to change or reload your gun as the zombies close in.

pages.title: Fairytale Fairies
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Fairytale Fairies is a makeover and dress-up game where princesses try a fairy-inspired style. Choose their makeup and combine fairy dresses to create a look for each girl. Use the mouse to select the available options, experimenting with different combinations as you turn the princesses' fashion plans into finished fairy outfits.

pages.title: Piano Tiles
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Piano Tiles challenges you to hit black tiles while leaving the light-colored ones untouched. Keep selecting the correct tiles to build your score, taking care not to strike a pale tile by mistake. Collect gems and stars during play and use them to gain access to more music, giving you additional songs to try.

pages.title: Jewel Bubbles
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Bubbles is a match-three puzzle where you swap neighboring bubbles to form lines of matching colors. Make a horizontal or vertical run of at least three to clear it. Larger matches create special exploding bubbles, which can also be combined for stronger effects. Check each level's objective and use your matches to meet it while aiming for a three-star result.

pages.title: Heroic Dash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Heroic Dash sends a hero along a route that requires turns and jumps over gaps. Click or tap to play, timing your actions to keep the journey going. Collect gems as you advance and spend them on additional heroes. The challenge is continuing along the path while gathering as many gems as you can.

pages.title: Easter Shooter Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Easter Shooter Game is a bubble-shooting puzzle that uses decorated Easter eggs as its targets. Tap to launch an egg toward a group of the same color and remove the eggs from the level. Plan your aim around the remaining clusters, clearing the field before any egg reaches the bottom boundary and ends the game.

pages.title: Double Date
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Double Date is a dress-up game about preparing Anna and Elsa for a movie night with their partners. Begin by choosing Anna's outfit, then help Elsa put together her own look. Pick clothing suited to their evening out and coordinate each princess's choices as you get both couples ready for the cinema.

pages.title: Pretty Prom Lovers
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Pretty Prom Lovers is a dress-up game about getting Selena and her boyfriend ready for prom. Choose outfits for the pair and put together looks for their evening at the dance. The focus is styling both characters, combining the available clothing choices to create a coordinated appearance for the occasion.

pages.title: Christmas Shooter Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Christmas Shooter Game turns bubble shooting into a puzzle filled with colored Christmas ornaments. Set the direction of your shot and launch a ball into others of the same color to remove them. Clear the arrangement while keeping every ornament above the bottom line. Each shot should help open space or remove a troublesome cluster before it comes too low.

pages.title: Mini Retro Bomber
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Mini Retro Bomber is a survival shooter about destroying bombs before they overwhelm your character. Hold the left mouse button to fire, aiming at the incoming threats while keeping out of their way. Bomb impacts reduce your health, so balance shooting with avoiding collisions. Stay alive and destroy more targets to build a higher score.

pages.title: Princess Annie Nails Salon!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a manicure in Princess Annie Nails Salon! Help Annie choose nail colors and combine them with the available accessories to finish the look. Try different combinations as you style her nails, deciding which colors and decorative choices work together for the result you want at her newly opened salon.

pages.title: Ellie and Jack Ice Dancing
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Ellie and Jack Ice Dancing is a preparation and dress-up game set just before an ice-dancing performance. Help the skater get the belongings she needs and choose an outfit for the show. Combine a skating costume with shoes and accessories, getting her ready to take part in the performance with an appropriate finished look.

pages.title: Monster Cake!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate a Halloween party cake in Monster Cake! Emma and her friends are preparing for their first celebration together, and you can help give the cake a spooky finish. Combine sweets with monsters, ghosts and spiderweb decorations, choosing how the different elements should look together on the party's centerpiece.

pages.title: Goldie Princess Tanning H5
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Princess Tanning H5 is a makeover game set during the princess's visit to a solarium. Follow the preparation steps, change her outfit and select a tan shade for her new appearance. Finish by choosing tattoos to go with the look. Tap through the styling choices to complete Goldie's summer-themed transformation.
